svg.title: Connected vehicle electronics. One platform.
svg.desc: A large illustrative ESP32 board connects to a small vehicle network. Device capabilities include inline CAN gateway and man-in-the-middle signal manipulation, LIN, diagnostics and calibration, recording and a local web interface. No functions or installation positions are marked inside the vehicle.

g.text: CAN gateways, signal manipulation and calibration alongside recording and local access.
